title: COLDCARD RNG Incident
description: A firmware integration mistake caused some COLDCARD models to generate wallet seeds through a predictable software PRNG instead of the intended hardware RNG. The incident shows how a plausible-looking random output, open source, and a released firmware binary can still leave users with a dangerously small key search space.
